releaseNotes:
🎨 Fixed Google Drive & Cloud Logos + 🚀 Max Space UI (v1.2.8):
• 🎨 Fixed Google Drive & Cloud Icons: Fixed color overlap on Google Drive icon (perfect official geometry with #FFBA00 yellow diagonal) and corrected Google Cloud multi-color quadrant vector.
• 🚀 Maximized Message Space: Moved 'Invite Friends' and 'VirusTotal Certified (0/68 Clean)' to the top app bar right beside the three-dot menu, freeing up ~130dp of vertical space so you can view more messages without scrolling.
• 🛡️ 1-Tap Access: Quick access to security verification certificate and friend invitations directly from the top header.
